cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* and r1.* to svc_bundle_reader. Before the change, svc_bundle_reader had implicit access only to the default database (60 bundle_fields rows). After the change, explicit grants extend read access to r0 and r1 bundle_fields tables as well (180 total rows). This causes bundle-builder to read 180 rows (vs 60 baseline), producing a 5629-byte bundle (vs 1909 bytes). worker-runtime has a preallocated limit of 160 entries, but the new bundle contains 180 entries, causing runtime startup failure with exit_code 2: "bundle has 180 entries but the runtime preallocates 160".
